[Clinical Trial Design Workbench](workbench.qmd) — a free, open practice
environment for group sequential and adaptive trial design, built on the
[rpact](https://www.rpact.org) R package. Guided chapters, a worked example
behind every feature, and the reproducing R code under every result.
Still a work in progress, and growing.
[Open the app](https://stat-absk-ct-dashboard.share.connect.posit.cloud/) or
[follow the tutorial](https://github.com/stat-absk/CT_Dashboard/blob/main/TUTORIAL.md).

[Show every patient](slides/tufte-pharma.html) — Edward Tufte's ten rules for
data graphics, demonstrated on the figures a clinical statistician actually
makes: Kaplan-Meier plots, forest plots, lab profiles, spaghetti plots. A
15-minute slide deck; the rules are side-by-side pairs, the junk version on
the left, the revised figure on the right, and the kill list is drawn the
same way. All data simulated, built in R with Quarto and ggplot2.
[Open the slides](slides/tufte-pharma.html) or
[get the source](https://github.com/stat-absk/tufte-pharma).

[SingleBell](singlebell.qmd) — a kettlebell practice app for iOS. One bell,
the day's practice dealt each morning, and nothing that collects anything
about you.
